name: Laplacian Frequency Hierarchy for 3DGS
definition: A training method that factorizes a single 3DGS scene representation into multiple frequency-specific Gaussian fields {G^{L-1}, ..., G^0} aligned with a Laplacian pyramid of training images. It reduces training workload by optimizing fields coarse-to-fine and composing their renderings in the image domain.
summary: Laplacian Frequency Hierarchy for 3DGS reduces training time and memory by optimizing frequency-specific Gaussian fields sequentially from coarse to fine, archiving completed fields to free GPU memory.
